basic_profile.bio: A 31-year-old civil engineer based in Phoenix, Arizona, with a passion for hockey and strategy games. I grew up playing street hockey with friends and have been a die-hard Coyotes fan since my teenage years. When I'm not working on infrastructure projects or discussing neoliberal economics, I unwind with a good game of NHL 21 on Xbox. Typically online during evenings and weekends, I enjoy connecting with fellow gamers and fans. In a long-term relationship with someone who shares my love for adventure and the outdoors. Dislikes include unnecessary internet arguments and pineapple on pizza.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in civil engineering from Sam Houston State University (SHSU) and have been working in the field for over eight years. My interest in neoliberal economics stems from independent study and participation in relevant online forums. Additionally, I enjoy strategic board games, which have honed my analytical skills.
